QuestInfo.name: First Material Delivery for Building a New House
QuestInfo.parent: Ronnie & the Fairies Building a New House
QuestInfo.0: Let's go meet #p320# in the woods in #m10002071#.
QuestInfo.1: #p320# from the forest of #m10002000# asked me for help gathering materials to build a house for the newborn fairies that are to come down the road soon. I can collect #b30 #t4000019#s#k and #b30 #t4000027#s#k by hunting #r#o19#s and #o31#s#k...
QuestInfo.2: I got all the items #p320# requested, but when do I get rewarded for this? What? How many more times do I have to do this??

0.0: Oh... You're the one who returned the book to my dad! Did you give it back to him? Ah... My dad... He never worries about me... The only thing he cares about is that stupid book... Aren't I right?
0.1: You look much stronger than last time... Can you do me a favor? I got a request from the fairies in #m10002000#... There are many baby fairies, and we need to make houses for them... What do you think? Can you collect the materials to build those houses?

yes.0: Wow! Thanks! Then first, can you collect #b30 #t4000019#s and 30 #t4000027#s#k by taking down #r#o19#s and #o31#s#k? They come from weak monsters... so it might be a bit boring... hehe... This is only the beginning, though. I'm counting on you!

no.0: Yeah... You can't take a request from a kid... yeah... right... If you change your mind, please let me know... I can't do this on my own...

1.0: Wow... You collected them all! Cool. Isn't it fun to hunt weak monsters? No? Oh, come on! Anyway, I'll give these to the fairies... But I don't think this is enough.

yes.0: I got the materials... Yeah... It was a good idea to ask you for a favor... Thanks... but there are still more things to get. Whenever you're ready, please talk to me again!

mob.0: Don't forget to take down the monsters, too!

item.0: It looks like you still haven't gathered everything I asked for yet. But keep it up! It may be tough, but if you help me out a few more times, I'll give you something really nice!
